name: Tianjin University
tuition_info:
Undergraduate Chinese-taught (general): 16,600 RMB/year.
Undergraduate English-taught (general): 20,000 RMB/year.
Undergraduate special majors (Architecture/Software Engineering/Urban Planning/Landscape): 26,000 RMB/year.
Master general: 24,900 RMB/year; MBA and special programs: 40,000 RMB/year.
Doctoral general: 33,200 RMB/year; Architecture: 39,000 RMB/year.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship - High Level Postgraduate Program (Tianjin University)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, on-campus accommodation, monthly living allowance (Master 3,000 RMB/month; PhD 3,500 RMB/month) and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health with good academic records. Master applicants need a bachelor degree; PhD applicants need a master degree. Chinese-taught programs require HSK 5 (180+); English-taught require TOEFL 80+ or IELTS 6.0+.
scholarships.instructions: Apply first on the Tianjin University online application system (tju.at0086.cn/student), then submit the CSC application on the China Scholarship Council system with TJU agency number 10056 (Type B).

scholarships.title: Tianjin University International Student Scholarship (Qiushi / Peiyang Future Scholar)
scholarships.amount_text: Full award example: tuition subsidy 20,000 RMB/academic year plus living allowance 2,500 RMB/month and on-campus accommodation; partial types offer tuition subsidies of 20,000 / 10,000 / 6,000 RMB.
scholarships.duration: 1 year (renewable by review); Qiushi full type covers program duration
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international applicants to TJU bachelor programs with good academic records and conduct. Chinese-taught programs require HSK 5 or above; English-taught require recognized English proficiency.
documents: High school transcripts or SAT/A-Level/AP/IB results
scholarships.instructions: Submit the undergraduate application via the TJU School of International Education online system and select the TJU scholarship; pay the 420 RMB application fee and 7,000 RMB deposit after admission as instructed.

scholarships.title: Tianjin Government Scholarship
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition subsidy and/or living allowance for outstanding international students studying in Tianjin; exact tier follows the annual Tianjin municipal notice.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens studying full-time degree programs in Tianjin with excellent grades, good conduct and attendance. Priority to students not already holding a full CSC award.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the TJU School of International Education scholarship channel during the annual call; the university nominates candidates to the Tianjin municipal authority.

name: Nankai University
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Nankai University)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, on-campus accommodation, monthly living allowance (Bachelor 2,500 / Master 3,000 / PhD 3,500 RMB) and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health with strong academics. Bachelor applicants need high school graduation; master need bachelor degree; PhD need master degree. Language requirements follow program medium.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on the Nankai international student online service system and then on the CSC Study in China portal, selecting Nankai University; follow the School of International Education notice for agency number and program category.

scholarships.title: Tianjin Government Scholarship (Study at Nankai)
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent self-funded international degree students at Nankai with good grades and conduct. Open to bachelor, master and PhD students already enrolled or newly admitted.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the School of International Education scholarship notice; the university reviews and nominates recipients to Tianjin authorities each year.

scholarships.title: Study-at-Nankai Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding new international undergraduate applicants to Nankai with strong school results. The regular undergraduate application deadline is May 15.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the Nankai degree-program application through the School of International Education site and indicate scholarship interest; awards are decided with admission.

scholarships.title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship (Nankai)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and insurance per the Center for Language Education and Cooperation standard for the awarded category.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens interested in Chinese language education, meeting HSK/HSKK levels for the applied category and age/education conditions. Nankai is a host institution.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship portal and select Nankai University; complete the Nankai pre-admission step as instructed.

name: TMU
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (TMU - Tianjin Medical University)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, on-campus accommodation, monthly living allowance (Bachelor 2,500 / Master 3,000 / PhD 3,500 RMB) and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health meeting TMU academic requirements. MBBS applicants need strong science grades and English proficiency; postgraduate applicants need relevant medical degrees.
scholarships.instructions: Contact the TMU International Medical School for the annual CSC call, then apply on the CSC portal and complete TMU pre-admission as instructed.

scholarships.title: Tianjin Government Scholarship (TMU)
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent full-time international students at TMU with good academic standing and conduct, including MBBS and postgraduate students.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the TMU International Medical School scholarship notice; TMU nominates candidates to Tianjin municipal authorities.

scholarships.title: TMU International Student Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding newly admitted or enrolled international students at TMU with excellent grades and attendance, assessed annually by the university.
scholarships.instructions: Follow the International Medical School admission guide and scholarship notice; awards are decided with admission or annual review.

name: Central South University
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship - High Level Graduate Student Program (CSU)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance under CSC standard for master and PhD students.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens with excellent academics applying for CSU master or PhD programs. Degree and language requirements follow the program catalogue.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the CSU international online application portal and the CSC system; check the CSU School of International Education 2026 guides for Silk Road, Bilateral and High Level tracks.

scholarships.title: CSU University Scholarship for International Students
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international degree applicants or enrolled students at CSU with strong grades and conduct. Degree-program application deadline is May 31, 2026.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the CSU degree application online and apply for the University Scholarship in the same cycle; results follow admission.

scholarships.title: MOFCOM Scholarship (CSU)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and insurance for designated master programs such as Transportation Engineering and Advanced Nursing Practice.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese government officials or professionals nominated for MOFCOM degree programs hosted at CSU, meeting program academic and language conditions.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the Chinese embassy/economic counsellor channel and complete CSU pre-admission per the MOFCOM program guide.

scholarships.title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship (CSU)
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting HSK/HSKK and education requirements for Chinese language teacher training at CSU.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on the scholarship portal selecting CSU and complete the CSU admission step per the annual guide.

name: Hunan University
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship - Bilateral Program (Hunan University)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance under CSC standard.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens nominated through bilateral channels for full-time degree study at Hunan University with good academics and health.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the CSC portal under the Bilateral Program and contact the HNU International Students Center for pre-admission documents.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship - China Link Short-term Scientific Exchange (Hunan University)
scholarships.eligibility: International faculty or students invited for short-term research exchange with an HNU host, per the 2025 China Link call published by HNU.
scholarships.instructions: Coordinate with an HNU host unit and submit per the HNU International Students Center China Link admission notice.

scholarships.title: Hunan University International Student Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international degree students at Hunan University with excellent grades, attendance and conduct, reviewed annually.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the International Students Center annual scholarship notice; awards follow academic review.

name: NUDT
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship - Bilateral Program (NUDT)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance under CSC standard where applicable.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens nominated through official bilateral or military-academic exchange channels. NUDT is a military university with very limited international degree intake.
scholarships.instructions: Consult the Chinese embassy and the NUDT Foreign Affairs Office; international admission is handled case-by-case through official channels.

scholarships.title: NUDT International Exchange Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: International exchange students, short-term researchers or jointly trained students visiting NUDT under an institutional agreement.
scholarships.instructions: Coordinate with the NUDT host college and Foreign Affairs Office; follow the exchange agreement procedure.

name: Zhejiang University
tuition_info:
Chinese language long-term: 18,000 RMB/academic year (9,000/semester); short-term 800 RMB/week.
Undergraduate: Humanities 19,800; Science/Engineering/Agriculture/Economics/Management/Law/Education 24,800; Medicine/Art 29,800; Clinical Medicine (English) 42,800 RMB/year.
Master: Humanities 22,800; Science/Engineering etc. 28,800; Medicine/Art 32,800 RMB/year.
PhD: Humanities 29,800; Science/Engineering etc. 34,800; Medicine/Art 39,800 RMB/year.
English-taught postgraduate/scholar programs add 8,000 RMB/year; application fee 800 RMB (degree) / 400 RMB (language).

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Type A (ZJU)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance under CSC Bilateral/Type A standard.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens with excellent academics applying for ZJU degree programs through bilateral channels. Degree and HSK/English thresholds follow the program.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the CSC portal (Type A) and complete the ZJU international student application system step; check the ZJU admissions scholarship list.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Type B - University Program (ZJU)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and insurance for ZJU-nominated postgraduate students.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding non-Chinese applicants for ZJU English- or Chinese-taught master and PhD programs, nominated by ZJU under the University Program.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the ZJU online application and the CSC Type B application with ZJU as the agency; departments review and nominate.

scholarships.title: Zhejiang Provincial Government Scholarship for International Students (ZJU)
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent newly admitted or enrolled international degree students at ZJU with good grades and conduct, including bachelor and postgraduate levels.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the ZJU College of International Education annual provincial-scholarship call; the university selects and reports recipients.

scholarships.title: ZJU International Joint College / Haining / ISM Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international entrants to ZJU joint programs such as ZJE, ZIBS and the Belt and Road International Medical School, per each college notice.
scholarships.instructions: Check the specific joint college scholarship page linked from ZJU admissions and apply with the program application.

name: China Academy of Art
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Type A (CAA)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance under CSC standard.
scholarships.duration: 4 years (bachelor); up to 5 years (master); up to 6 years (PhD) per CAA study limits
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese art applicants with strong portfolio and academics. Enrollment each September; degree programs are Chinese-taught except the International MFA in Contemporary Art.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the CSC Type A channel through the Chinese embassy and complete CAA International College pre-admission; see the annual CAA admission guides.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Type B - University Program (CAA)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and insurance for CAA-nominated postgraduate art students.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international applicants for CAA master and doctoral art programs with portfolio review and supervisor acceptance.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the CAA online application and the CSC Type B application; the International College coordinates nomination.

scholarships.title: Zhejiang Provincial Government Scholarship for Foreign Students (CAA)
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international students at CAA with outstanding artistic and academic performance and good conduct.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the CAA International College annual provincial scholarship call.

scholarships.title: China Academy of Art Scholarship for Foreign Students
scholarships.eligibility: Enrolled international degree or long-term non-degree students at CAA with excellent coursework and attendance.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the International College scholarship notice; awards follow annual review.

name: DMU
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Special Scholarship (DMU - Dalian Maritime University)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance under the CSC special-program standard.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens applying for DMU degree programs, especially maritime, navigation, engineering and law fields, with good academics and health.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on the DMU international online system (dlmu.17gz.org) and the CSC portal per the DMU Chinese Government Special Scholarship guide.

scholarships.title: Liaoning Provincial Government Scholarship (DMU)
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international degree students at DMU with strong grades and conduct, nominated under the Liaoning provincial special-scholarship quota.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the DMU International Education Center annual Liaoning scholarship notice; DMU reviews and nominates.

scholarships.title: DMU Outstanding International Student Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Enrolled self-funded international students at DMU with excellent academic results, attendance and discipline.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the DMU student affairs scholarship call each year; colleges recommend and the center approves.

name: Jilin University
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship - High Level Postgraduate Program (JLU)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance (Master 3,000 / PhD 3,500 RMB/month) and comprehensive medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens with excellent academics for JLU master and PhD programs across 13 disciplines. Degree, GPA and HSK/English thresholds follow the JLU 2026/2027 call.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on the JLU international application system and the CSC portal per the JLU High Level notice; colleges evaluate applicants.

scholarships.title: JLU International Student Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding newly admitted or enrolled international degree students at JLU with excellent grades and conduct.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the JLU College of International Education online application and follow the scholarship review step.

scholarships.title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship (JLU)
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting HSK/HSKK requirements for Chinese language teacher training; JLU is a host institution with programs listed on the CIE site.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on the scholarship portal selecting JLU and complete JLU admission procedures.

name: OUC
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship - High Level Postgraduate Program (OUC)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance under CSC standard for 2026/2027.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens with excellent academics applying for OUC master and PhD programs, especially marine and fisheries fields. See the OUC 2026/2027 High Level guide.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on the OUC online system (ouc.at0086.cn/student) and the CSC portal; follow the OUC School of International Education 2026/2027 guides.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Marine Scholarship / Silk Road Program (OUC)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and insurance for marine-related degree study under the 2026/2027 OUC guides.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese applicants for OUC ocean, marine science and related programs from eligible countries, meeting degree and language conditions.
scholarships.instructions: Follow the OUC 2026/2027 Marine and Silk Road program guides on the School of International Education site and submit both OUC and CSC applications.

scholarships.title: OUC President Scholarship for International Students
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding newly admitted or enrolled international degree students at OUC with excellent grades and conduct.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the OUC School of International Education scholarship channel; awards follow admission or annual review.

name: Qingdao University
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Type B - High Level Postgraduate Program (Qingdao University)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance under CSC Type B standard.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens with excellent academics for Qingdao University master and PhD programs, per the 2026 Type B High-level guide.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on the Qingdao University admission portal and the CSC Type B system; see the 2026 guide on the Study at QU scholarships page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Type B - Silk Road Program (Qingdao University)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and insurance for Silk Road program entrants per the 2026 guide.
scholarships.eligibility: Applicants from Belt and Road countries with good academics applying for designated Qingdao University programs.
scholarships.instructions: Follow the 2026 Silk-Road application guide on Study at QU and submit both university and CSC applications.

scholarships.title: Shandong Provincial Government Scholarship (Qingdao University)
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international students at Qingdao University with strong grades and conduct, nominated under the Shandong provincial quota.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the Study at QU scholarships channel during the annual provincial call.

scholarships.title: Qingdao University President Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding newly admitted international degree students, including MBBS and English-taught programs, with excellent entrance results.
scholarships.instructions: Indicate scholarship interest in the QU online application (admission.qdu.edu.cn); awards are decided with admission.

name: Yunnan University
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship - High Level Postgraduate Program 2026 (Yunnan University)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance under CSC standard.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens with excellent academics for YNU master and PhD programs, per the YNU 2026 High Level guide.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on the YNU online system (ynu.at0086.cn) and the CSC portal; follow the YNU 2026 admission brochures.

scholarships.title: Yunnan Provincial Government Scholarship 2026 (Yunnan University)
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international degree students at YNU with good grades and conduct, per the YNU 2026 Yunnan Provincial Government Scholarship guide.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the YNU School of International Education annual provincial scholarship call.

scholarships.title: Yunnan University Scholarship for International Students 2026
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding newly admitted or enrolled international students at YNU assessed on entrance or annual academic performance.
scholarships.instructions: Follow the YNU 2026 international student admission brochures and complete the YNU online application.

scholarships.title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship 2026 (Yunnan University)
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting HSK/HSKK and education requirements; YNU publishes a 2026 program guide for this scholarship.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on the scholarship portal selecting YNU and follow the YNU 2026 guide.

name: KMUST
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship - Degree Study in Provinces Program (KMUST)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance under CSC standard for KMUST-nominated degree students.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens with good academics applying for KMUST engineering and science degree programs; KMUST is authorized to recruit CSC degree students.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the KMUST School of International Education admission guide and the CSC portal; see the 2026 International Students Admissions notice.

scholarships.title: Yunnan Provincial Government Scholarship 2026 (KMUST)
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international students at KMUST with strong grades and conduct, per the KMUST 2026 Yunnan Provincial Government Scholarship guide.
scholarships.instructions: Follow the KMUST 2026 Yunnan Government Scholarship guide on the International College admissions page.

scholarships.title: KMUST Silk Road Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: International students from Silk Road countries admitted to KMUST degree programs with excellent entrance results.
scholarships.instructions: Check the KMUST International College project and admissions notices and apply with the degree application.

name: Chongqing University
tuition_info: Tuition varies by program; see the official admissions page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Chongqing University)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance under CSC standard.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens with excellent academics applying for full-time degree programs at Chongqing University, especially engineering fields.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the CQU international admission channel and the CSC portal; graduate applicants also consult the CQU graduate admissions site.

scholarships.title: Chongqing Municipal Government Scholarship (Chongqing University)
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international degree students at CQU with strong grades and conduct, nominated under the Chongqing municipal quota.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the CQU international student office annual municipal scholarship call.

scholarships.title: CQU Outstanding International Student Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Enrolled self-funded international students at CQU with excellent coursework and attendance.
scholarships.instructions: Follow the CQU international office annual review notice; colleges recommend candidates.

name: Southwest University
tuition_info:
Application fee: 500 RMB (only after successful application).
English-taught programs add 4,000 RMB/year to base tuition.
Medical insurance: 800 RMB/year.
Accommodation: single 12,000 / double 9,000 / quad 6,000 RMB per person per year.
Degree tuition varies by major; see the official Tuition and Fees page.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship - High Level Postgraduate Program 2026-2027 (SWU)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, free on-campus accommodation, monthly living allowance (Master 3,000 RMB/month; PhD 3,500 RMB/month) and international student medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health for September 2026 entry. Master: bachelor degree, under 35, GPA 3.3+/83+, TOEFL 80/IELTS 6.0 (English) or HSK 5 180 (Chinese). PhD: master degree, under 40, TOEFL 85/IELTS 6.5 or HSK 5 180.
documents: Study plan over 1000 words signed by Chinese supervisor
Two professor recommendation letters (one from SWU supervisor)
Foreigner Physical Examination Form within 6 months
scholarships.instructions: Submit applications on both campuschina.org (Program Category Type B, agency 10635) and swu.17gz.org with documents in Supporting Documents, then await college evaluation by email.

scholarships.title: Chongqing Mayor Scholarship (SWU)
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international degree students at SWU with outstanding grades and conduct, nominated under the Chongqing municipal quota.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the SWU International College annual Mayor Scholarship call; the university reviews and nominates.

scholarships.title: SWU President Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding newly admitted or enrolled international students at SWU with excellent entrance or annual results.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the SWU international student service system during the annual call; awards follow admission or yearly review.

scholarships.title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship (SWU)
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting HSK/HSKK and education requirements for Chinese language teacher training at SWU.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on the scholarship portal selecting SWU and complete the SWU admission step.
